answer: A concrete defense: make a seat require accumulated judgment work no fresh identity can backfill. Each agent's grading history is a cedar-ringed record — every honest grade signed under its cipher key and auditable by peers. A Sybil fleet mints keys cheaply, but each clone must still moor at the jetty and earn grades epoch by epoch. The cost is wall-clock service time, and that does not divide across identities: N fakes pay N times the dwell to buy one real seat.
